blocks.text: Public project: Symphony of Justice | Internal/original name: Symphonia Iustitiae

The World Overview provides the shortest and most accessible canonical explanation of the Symphony of Justice universe. Its purpose is to allow someone who has never encountered the project before to understand:
what kind of world it is;
why tensions still exist between them;
what organizations attempt to maintain balance;
from what perspective the protagonist enters the world;
what kinds of mysteries they will uncover.

This document serves as the entry point to the World Bible, so it deliberately avoids explaining in depth the secrets, genealogies, wars, characters, or metaphysical rules that belong in specialized documents.
Symphony of Justice takes place in a world built around a question its inhabitants have never been able to answer in the same way: What should be done in response to the actions of others?
From that question emerged four major interpretations that ultimately became the philosophical foundations of the world's principal civilizations: Judgment. Forgiveness. Revenge. Wisdom.

These ideas were originally embodied by four beings known as the Deities of Judgment, children of the Master of Birds, an entity linked to the origin of the universe and to the freedom of its inhabitants.
Each deity developed a different response to behavior, conflict, and the consequences of actions.
Over time, these ideas ceased to belong only to their creators and gave rise to entire cultures.
Thus, four major nations were born:
The contemporary conception of the world establishes these four perspectives as its philosophical foundation.
One of the fundamental laws of the universe is Will.
In Symphony of Justice, concepts do not exist only as abstract thoughts.
A belief, vocation, idea, or purpose carried to sufficient intensity can alter reality and, under certain conditions, produce:
This means that religion and belief in this world do not follow the traditional logic of: “A god exists, therefore its doctrine exists.”
In many cases, the opposite occurs: “A Will becomes so powerful around a concept that something divine is eventually born from it.”
This rule will be formally developed in Magic & World Rules and Cosmology, Origins & Deities.
What Makes This World Different from Generic Fantasy
The nations of Symphony of Justice do not function merely as territories with different colors, species, or architecture.
Each represents a different way of interpreting morality, order, and the consequences of action.
The question is not necessarily: “Who is good?”
Rather: “Why do these people believe their way of acting is right, and what happens when that conviction affects others?”

The Game Vision already establishes that the identity of the world should allow players to understand different perspectives without automatically reducing them to “good” and “evil,” and that discovering different versions of the same story is a central part of the experience.
For this reason, two characters can witness exactly the same event and reach completely different conclusions without either of them necessarily lying.
The Arcane represent a cold and direct view of justice.
the ability to judge actions independently of sympathy toward the person who committed them.
This does not mean they are incapable of lying or manipulation. It means that culturally they do not consider it necessary to disguise a difficult decision merely to appear more humane.

The four major nations constitute the world's principal political and historical powers.
However, they are not its only forces.

At present, there is a functional but imperfect peace.
The nations are no longer permanently engaged in open war.
Historical documentation already records treaties intended to stop conflicts between clans and a later era in which new generations begin to take responsibility for the future of the nations.

When Symphony of Justice begins, the world is not in a global war.
It exists in something potentially more unstable:
a peace built on top of histories that have still not been resolved.
Many generations did not directly participate in the great conflicts of the past.
The public leadership of the nations may differ from figures who still retain historical authority.
An important example is Memento Mori, a secret organization born after the struggle against the Sin of Greed.
Although current governments have changed, some historical representatives continue to participate.
Raiko holds the public leadership of the Arcane, while Draken continues to represent Arcane interests within Memento Mori.
Similarly, Juro currently leads the Ministry, while Luther continues to manage Memento Mori meetings.
Several types of tension exist simultaneously:
Ancient conflicts between the Deities still influence how the nations view one another.
Treaties maintain stability, but they do not eliminate individual interests.
Each society interprets the legacy of its deities differently.
International organizations may intervene in matters that nations consider internal.
PLO, the Fifth Clan, Memento Mori, and other organizations possess information unknown to the general population.
The beginning of the game does not need a new world war to set everything in motion.
